messages:
Anya: heads up — since the model rollout at 00:00 us-west1c our warm pools have been draining fast. lots of small GPU pods stuck Pending and preempted. noticed nvlink error spikes too.
Matt: can you paste the `kubectl get pods` / node pressure?
Anya: short dump — many small-infer pods Pending with `FailedAttach` / `Preempted` events, warmpool size dropped from 120 -> 18 in 20m. preempt rate ~3x baseline.
Ciara: the batcher team pushed a new packing heuristic that bundles by token-length window, meant to improve throughput for long sequences. could be biasing allocation to long-seq jobs.
Zhen: confirmed — telemetry shows a huge shift: 70% of tokens now from long-running fine-tune workloads. packing bins are filling nvlink lanes and creating hotspot nodes, so small jobs get squeezed to tail and then preempted.
infra-bot: ALERT: us-west1c warmpool depletion (threshold breach) at 8456789123. affected pods: 92 small-gpu inference, preempt events: 184.
Matt: ugh. this is two interacting problems: binpack heuristic + AZ egress noisiness. small pods rely on warmpools for latency SLO — can't sustain this.
Ciara: quick mitigation: revert packing heuristic or enable a short-term `seq_class=small` label to keep tiny pods on separate warm nodes. revert takes ~10m.
Zhen: also seeing `net-conntrack` backlog on certain racks — that increases attach latencies, so pods miss warm attach window and get scheduled elsewhere then preempted.
SRE Oncall: immediate action: 1) rollback batcher change (Ciara) 2) increase warm pool min to 150 for us-west1c (Matt/infra) 3) patch small-pod admission to set `seq_class=small` until we have a better binning policy.
Anya: Ciara — can you revert? I'll run a `kubectl patch` for the warmpool CR to bump min size.
Ciara: reverting now. rolling back commit abf12. will monitor.
Matt: warmpool min bumped, running `kubectl -n infra patch warmpool us-west1c -p '{"spec":{"minSize":150}}'` — watchers: please watch preempt count.
infra-bot: ACTION: rollback started by Ciara at 8456789180. warmpool minScale updated at 8456789204.
Zhen: early signs good — pending queue dropping, small pods being admitted. nvlink errors falling. but we still have leftover stragglers on some racks with conntrack backlog.
SRE Oncall: follow-ups: 1) add a metric for token-length skew per tenant 2) add placement hint `seq_class` in scheduler to avoid token-binning thrash 3) long-term: roll out spill-aware packing that hedges for small-pod latency.
Anya: logging a postmortem ticket with perf traces and agenda for packing policy. thanks all for the quick revert. :thumbsup:
Matt: added runbook note: if warmpool < 30% of baseline, bump to baseline+20% and notify infra.
Ciara: will open a PR for `seq_class` label + admission mutator to tag tiny pods automatically.
Zhen: I'll follow up on the conntrack drain for those racks (network infra).
infra-bot: RESOLVED: warmpool depletion cleared at 8456789380.
Anya: closing thread, leaving notes in the ticket for next-week postmortem.
